acceptance_criteria: The homepage opens in English and offers an Arabic RTL switch with translated web project guidance.
The HTML and web interfaces picker displays paired readiness and copies the selected language's request in a real browser.
The default README is English, links the Arabic version, and explains how to check both skills.
The verified integration and homepage commits are visible on the GitHub main ref.
GitHub validation, security, and Pages deployment are observed for the exact delivered head.
The deployed GitHub Pages homepage exposes the English default, RTL language switch, and working prompt copy.
